definition: Field links records to a primary key in an external table.
Field is a standard attribute column with no dependencies on an external table.
Field serves as the unique identifier for each row in this table.

Field is optional and accepts empty cells and missing values.

Field does not require unique values; the same value can be repeated across multiple rows.
